subject.title: fix(compaction): retain CJK sessions within token budget

question: Should `@openclaw/normalization-core/cjk-chars` become a supported public package subpath for standalone agent-core and distributed root artifacts?
rationale: The functional repair is narrow and validated, but accepting a new exported package subpath establishes an external compatibility contract that cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the public subpath
options.body: Merge the branch as written and treat the CJK helper subpath as a supported normalization-core contract.

options.title: Use an existing export surface
options.body: Ask for a narrow revision that shares the helper through an already-approved package entry point while preserving the compaction coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept the public subpath
recommendation.body: Merge the branch as written and treat the CJK helper subpath as a supported normalization-core contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work is the closest recent ownership signal for the compaction content-block boundary affected by this change.
